scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json && pnpm -r --if-present typecheck
scripts.rust:check: node scripts/game-run.mjs cargo fmt --all --check && node scripts/game-run.mjs cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && node scripts/game-run.mjs cargo test --workspace
scripts.desktop:build: node scripts/game-run.mjs pnpm --filter @noren/desktop exec tauri build
scripts.licenses:check: node scripts/check-licenses.mjs && node scripts/game-run.mjs cargo deny check licenses
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm readme:check && pnpm test && pnpm rust:check
